primary_variables.matched_definition: Comparison between wild-type and mutant or variant alleles, proteins, or genotypes.
evidence: we investigated the effects of three central disease-associated amino acid changes (p.E388K, p.R395C and p.D409H) within the interface on the interaction of GCase and LIMP-2
on the LIMP-2 side, we selected the previously identified variants p.Y163C... and p.F191S
we generated the artificial variants p.K181S and p.R192S to disrupt the two identified salt bridges
Two artificial p.H171A and p.H171K variants previously described by Zachos et al. were also included as controls
